split: All non-US development; US 50% calibration and 50% final evaluation
preprocessing: Nonpositive pulse/sysbp treated as missing; median imputation fitted in development only
calibration: Logistic intercept/slope fitted on separate US calibration half
threshold_interpretation: Exploratory mathematical grid, not clinically justified intervention thresholds
bootstrap_interpretation: Paired evaluation patients; fitted models and calibration fixed. No training uncertainty or center-cluster inference.
joint_band: Bootstrap max absolute error across both statuses, three paired estimands and all 30 thresholds
limitations: Same historical trial, not a separate contemporary cohort
No known true population net benefit or clinical regret
No tuning, seed search or filtering of negative results
